items.question: How much does it cost the shipper?
items.answer: Nothing. You pay only for the move, and directly to the carrier.

items.question: Who is responsible for the cargo?
items.answer: The carrier. We check their documents, licence and insurance before they get access to jobs.

items.question: When is the launch?
items.answer: The pilot starts in early 2027. We'll open the centre of the country first, then other areas as carriers join. Those who left their details will hear first.

items.question: I'm not in the centre of the country — is it worth leaving my details?
items.answer: Yes. We collect requests from across the country and open areas as carriers join.

checklist: Jobs come to you — a notification arrives and you decide whether to take it.

The client is real: phone verified, job described.
Payment for the move goes directly to you.

items.question: How much does it cost the carrier?
items.answer: Nothing during the pilot. Then there will be a subscription: we'll announce the terms at least a month ahead and discuss them with the first participants. Founding carriers get better terms.

items.question: Do I need to upload documents right away?
items.answer: No. We'll check documents, licence and insurance at onboarding — before you get access to jobs.

items.question: Can I skip working on Shabbat?
items.answer: Yes. Each carrier states whether they work on Shabbat. Jobs on those days are shown only to those who do.

items.question: Are you a transport company?
items.answer: No. We have no trucks of our own. We're a marketplace where the two sides find each other and agree directly.

about.title: It started with our own move
about.lead: The idea came from our own move: half a day on the phone, three different prices for the same job, and in the end a deal with someone we knew nothing about.
paragraphs: We looked at how this market works in Israel and saw that it's barely touched by digital. Thousands of carriers, hundreds of thousands of moves a year — and no shared place where you can see them. Everyone gets by on their own: some through groups, some through friends, some through middlemen who take a cut simply for having a phone book.

Novil is an attempt to bring this market into one place. We have no trucks of our own and we take no money for the move. Our job is for you to find each other and know who you're dealing with. We're at the very beginning, so we'll talk to the first participants personally.
